No substantial work has been completed since before Christmas, because they do no pay their bills and no one wants to work with them!!!!  @proprojects-- you are actively selling work to offset past jobs or flat out steal from people, I would love to see your response to this!!

data.summary: Reviews indicate a severe and consistent pattern of unethical business practices, including taking full payment, ghosting customers, not paying subcontractors, and leaving projects unfinished, leading to property liens. The two positive reviews are old and vague, while the negative reviews are recent, detailed, and corroborate each other. This appears to be a legitimate case of a failing or fraudulent contractor, not fake reviews.
fake_signals: Only two 5-star reviews are generic and lack detail
5-star reviews are from 3 years ago, while numerous detailed 1-star complaints are from 2 years ago, suggesting a potential decline or pattern emerging
Lack of any recent positive reviews to counter the severe allegations
authentic_signals: 1-star reviews are highly detailed with specific allegations (liens, $120k paid, subcontractor names, 1-year delays)
Multiple independent reviewers describe the same core issues (non-payment to subs, ghosting, liens)
Emotional language and specific grievances match patterns of genuine customer distress
complaint_patterns: Not paying subcontractors leading to liens
data.discrepancy_explanation: Low rating is consistent across the single platform with reviews. BBB rating is low but not contradictory.
